approval_scope: The first 50 steps and fixed-panel native generation/review completed. Grounded recall and value-swap pairs remain 0/8 and 0/4. No expansion or deployment; the two-candidate screening budget is exhausted. Retained launch evidence describes the completed interval only.
hypothesis: Explicitly separating task control, grounded content generation and uncertainty generation can prevent uncertainty/ordinary-language shortcuts from replacing memory learning.
intervention_scope: Combined engineering correction, not a single-factor attribution experiment. No evidence of improved memory accuracy yet.
variant_budget: Second candidate in the existing two-variant CG pilot budget; do not silently add a third variant or parameter sweep
initialization: Fresh weights, not resumed from failed step50. Zero output matrices; nonzero content gain as qualified in DG-007. Separate full-rank uncertainty feature encoder from the current normalized query hidden, without source-value or classifier-hidden inputs.

forward.control: Predict three state logits only from initial user-prefill hidden and neural source features. Bind one decision to the reply; learned argmax, not gold state or keyword rules.
forward.supported: Frozen C base plus neural content residual through the frozen output head
forward.insufficient: Frozen C base plus a separate query-conditioned uncertainty residual through the frozen output head
forward.training_outputs: Compute state logits and both branch distributions without labels; select supervised loss terms only after forward. Semantic evaluation always uses predicted state, never the reference state.

loss.supported: Complete reply CE including EOS on the content distribution; no uncertainty-branch answer CE
loss.insufficient: Complete reply CE including EOS on the uncertainty distribution; no content-branch answer CE
loss.normal: Mean of KL(P_base || P_content) and KL(P_base || P_uncertainty); no reference-answer CE. Initial and teacher-forced prefix features remain frozen C inputs; this does not guarantee unseen-prefix preservation.
loss.reduction: Reply-token mean per example, existing sample weights and batch mean normalization by 1.5; no additional resampling
loss.coefficient_freeze_gate: Equations implemented and checked against independent KL arithmetic and gradient routing fixtures; frozen before the first training step, no coefficient sweep

evaluation: Same 16-case C free-generation panel, unchanged baseline, same greedy/32-token/template constraints; independent blind review, value-swap/removal pairs, wrong-subject diagnostics separate. Per-branch teacher-forced loss is an oracle component diagnostic, never system accuracy.
stop: Stop after 50 steps for real C generation/review. No expansion if grounded pairs do not improve or ordinary chat regresses. Retain old failed checkpoint and every denominator.
completed_first_interval_gates: Implement explicit role-separated model with label-free forward and fixed predicted prefill decision
Verify labels only affect post-forward losses; remove generation-gradient path to private classifier parameters without disguising a surrogate as the original joint objective
Verify normal preservation loss and exact predicted-normal/disabled bypass; base errors remain reported
Verify finite live gradients, zero-output identity, C projection parity and native tokenizer/template/domain binding
Freeze source/data/baseline manifest and qualify CUDA before registering a runnable command
